==Walkthrough==
===Starting out===
{{Checklist|'''''Items required: '''None''
*Talk to the monk outside of the [[Paterdomus Temple]], which is east of [[Varrock]]. {{Chat option|1Sure thing, what do you need?}} (You can use [[fairy ring]] code {{Fairycode|CKS}} and then run west and climb the shortcut to arrive there quickly). }}

===A strange weapon===
{{Checklist|'''''Items required: '''[[bow string]], ''[[Mithril 2h sword]] or 3 [[mithril bars]] and a hammer
*Go to [[Doric]]'s house north of [[Falador]].
*Use the [[mithril 2h sword]] on Doric's Whetstone to make a [[slender blade]].
*Attach the [[bow string]] to it to make the [[bow-sword]].}}

===A gift for Entrana===
{{Checklist|'''''Items required: '''[[Large pouch]], food/prayer for the Abyss enemies''
*Head back to the monk. {{Chat option|1Yep, got it right here for you.}}
*Use the [[Orb (Devious Minds)|orb]] on the [[Large pouch]].
**[[File:Ultimate ironman chat badge.png]] Ultimate Ironmen: The Large pouch is lost upon death if the orb is inside it. Use the orb on the pouch only after 'banking' for Entrana.
*Bank your [[weapons]] and [[armour]] and take out supplies to protect against the monsters in the [[Abyss]].
*Go to the [[Law Altar]] through the [[Abyss]].
*Exit the portal and head to the church on Entrana.}}


===Surprise!===
{{Checklist|*Use the pouch on the church altar and wait for the cut-scene to finish.
*Talk to the [[High Priest]].
*Head back to the monk in [[Paterdomus]].
*Search the [[Dead Monk]].
*Go back to [[Entrana]] and speak with the [[High Priest (Entrana)|High Priest]]. ([[Rat Pits]] [[Minigame Teleport]] will take players to Port Sarim. Requires [[Ratcatchers]] quest. Players can also use the Minigame [[Pest Control]] teleport which is very close to Port Sarim)
*Head to [[Falador]] Park and talk to [[Sir Tiffy Cashien]]. {{Chat option|1Devious Minds.}}
*'''Congratulations, quest complete!'''}}
